text.description_html:
Schlage Encode™ Smart WiFi Deadbolt with Greenwich Trim

The Schlage Encode Deadbolt has built-in WiFi allows you to lock/unlock from anywhere, plus set up guest access codes for recurring, temporary or permanent access when paired with the Schlage Home app, no additional accessories required. With the Encode you can create and manage up to 100 access codes for trusted friends and family to use with the fingerprint-resistant, capacitive touchscreen with easy one-touch locking. Fits standard doors 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick with 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backset.

Features of the Schlage Encode™ Smart WiFi Deadbolt:

  • Fingerprint-resistant
  • One touch locking
  • Stores up to 100 user codes.
  • Built-in alarm technology senses potential security breaches at the lock
  • Works with Schlage Home, Hey Google, Alexa, Ring
  • Easy to install with just a screwdriver.
  • 3-Year electronics warranty.
  • Limited lifetime manufacture mechanical and finish warranty.
  • ADA Compliant

Specifications of the BE489WBGRW Encode WiFi Deadbolt:

  • ANSI/BHMA Commercial Grade 1
  • ADA Compliant
  • Exterior Height: 5"
  • Exterior Width: 3"
  • Exterior Projection: .9"
  • Interior Height: 5.5"
  • Interior Width: 3"
  • Interior Projection: .2.2"
  • Keying: 5-pin tumbler, C Keyway, 1 key included
  • WiFi compatibility: requires 2.4GHz WiFi network
  • Codes: Pre-set, unique 6-digit programming code, two pre-set unique 4-digit access codes, 100 code capacity
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-7/8" to 2-1/2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/4" or 2-3/8"
  • Battery: 4 AA alkaline
  • Schlage BE489WBGRW Installation and User Guide (PDF)

    • Note: For use with 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" Thick Doors.

    Sold Individually
